subject: Genetics
title: Genes Are Just the Start
description: Learn Genes Are Just the Start in one minute.

hook.text: Scientists expected 100,000 human genes. The genome revealed only 20,000. A fruit fly has 14,000. Humbling.

buildup.text: The gene count shattered the idea that complexity equals more genes. Humans aren't more complex by gene count.

discovery.text: Complexity comes from gene regulation—how and when genes are turned on. One gene can make many different proteins.

twist.text: Alternative splicing lets one gene produce multiple proteins. A single gene can have dozens of outputs. Efficiency.

climax.text: The genome project taught us that counting genes misses the point. The magic is in the regulatory network.

punchline.text: It's not how many genes you have. It's how you use them.

quiz.question: How many protein-coding genes do humans have?
